findings.decision: Keep sitta and every terrain word in the selected source. Classical commentary records the six-day variant; the dictionary supports, but does not certify, the provisional thickets rendering.
Explicitly derive Said from Sad using both inspected printed readings; retain original Arabic and the two separately located English labels.
Keep the absence-of-mention statement separate and anonymous. Mark the Khan opening damaged instead of silently repairing or borrowing it.
Retain the complete separately attributed addition. Ibn al-Mulaqqin relays criticism; Ibn Hajar disputes it and cites other transmissions. This review makes no grading decision.

Further print inspection clarifies that both Brill 260 and modern 248 omit the explicit Abu Abd Allah attribution; the selected digital text and Fath base quotation contain it. The immutable intake audit mentioned only the modern omission.
Preserve reddened trees, the explicit twice instruction and looking at the city within a surrounding wreath; do not replace these with the Khan paraphrases.
